runtime.timestamp_basis: As printed by sacct; no timezone offset supplied.
runtime.source: User-provided sacct -j 55467 -X -o JobID,State,Start,End,Elapsed output in this conversation; not independently queried from the cluster.
runtime.scope: Slurm job elapsed: includes five serial builds and fifteen solver runs with validation; excludes queue wait and subsequent review collection/transfer.
runtime.estimate_limit: Planning allowance for comparable source/fixture/schedule, not a guarantee or estimate for multi-node scaling campaigns.

correctness: All fifteen runs passed independent science, placement, storage, raw timing/observer, reload/remap, checkpoint and 62-member VTK checks. Five builds share 23 physics objects. Both 16/167-rank oracles retain 48 inverse-return proofs and 84 installations.

main.scope: Two independent runs per binary; compatibility does not prove each small scope unbiased.

stage266.scope: Two independent runs per binary; compatibility does not prove each small scope unbiased.

attribution.limitation: Current measured locations only if both calibrations pass; no omission or full replacement has been tested. Retain negative offsets, inclusive nesting and calibration failures.

comparison.limitation: Diagnostic attribution only; no intervention tested and no recoverable speedup established.

candidate_only.interpretation: Candidate calibration passes; broad component costs locate work but do not quantify avoidable time. Cross-version attribution remains unqualified.

J5-n83-timing-6-observer.limitations: Self times add within a rank/step. Inclusive times overlap. Longest-local-step composition selects one rank per step, not independent region maxima; unsynchronized local durations do not prove the global critical path. CPU includes MPI spinning. Work counters cover named inverse/cache products, not all solver traffic; doubles are logical payload counts, not physical memory traffic.

J5-n83-timing-7-observer.limitations: Self times add within a rank/step. Inclusive times overlap. Longest-local-step composition selects one rank per step, not independent region maxima; unsynchronized local durations do not prove the global critical path. CPU includes MPI spinning. Work counters cover named inverse/cache products, not all solver traffic; doubles are logical payload counts, not physical memory traffic.

candidate_only.rank_range_limit: Each rank mean averages nine ordinary steps in each of two runs. Values are not synchronized critical-path contributions; waits can reflect work on other ranks.

calibration_interpretation: Main mean shift and second pair exceed fixed limits; lower scope frequency does not prove residual shift is direct clock cost. Do not relax thresholds, subtract a flat correction, or present signed phase differences as a qualified decomposition of the legacy gap.
strategic_goal: Efficient execution at P >= 4*D; J5 D=160 requires >=640 ranks, multi-node. Current 83-rank cost audit and 167-rank oracle cannot establish that goal.
next_recommendation: Use candidate costs to prioritize the Domain-bound shared producer/capture/restriction chain, and a bounded migration-proof/plan audit. Next performance campaign should include an uninstrumented 83/160/256-rank Stage266 baseline and matched main where supported; any focused change must be compared at the same counts before acceptance. This is an intermediate screen, followed by >=640-rank multi-node qualification and adequate block subdivision.
review_limit: Binary/checkpoint/VTK payloads omitted; cluster-computed hashes and numerical reports verified, not rerun.
derived_report_float_tolerance: Eight ulps only; raw member hashes and all scientific gates remain exact.
